description: Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government - The Term of office of the  Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, 05.11.2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act, No. 15 of 1987. It contains a ministerial order that modifies the term of office for members of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, which constitutes a regulatory change under existing legislation. While it mentions Minister Wajira Abeywardana, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of statutory powers to amend a legal order.
